conviction_note: Balanced: a guide the street models below (FY consensus $213.2m vs $215-220m guide) plus a $135m Q4-to-date bookings release this morning argue for a reaffirmed or firmed outlook, but the stock ran +18% in five sessions (largely after peer BlackSky's raised guide), has fallen on both of its two prints including a beat-and-guide-above-consensus in August, and needs a +14% q/q Q3 after two flat $49.8m quarters; p_up 48 on a 10-point abs move, and the -0.3 finding sum agrees in sign and size.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue ~$57.0m (Earnings Whispers preview https://finviz.com/news/416251/hawkeye-360-must-prove-its-back-half-ramp-after-a-39-slide-since-last-report, 2026-11-04; second source therighttrader.com $56.5m; EW alternate page $58.09m), EPS -$0.03; FY2026 consensus $213.18m vs company guide $215-220m revenue, adj. EBITDA $30-36m (company guide, Q2 release https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001750704/000175070426000018/exhibit991-earningsrelease.htm, 2026-08-13). CEO said Q3 adj. EBITDA similar to Q2 ($7.0m) with a Q4 ramp. Two estimate sources agree within ~$0.5-1m, so the bar is usable.
positioning_check: Short interest ~3.0m shares, 3.8% of float, days to cover 1.9-2.4 (stocktitan https://www.stocktitan.net/overview/HAWK/ read 2026-11-12; equibles settlement tagged 2026-11-04 3.8%/2.4d; finviz 2026-11-12 short float 4.17%, ratio 2.06). Not crowded, so no squeeze mechanism behind a negative. Skew -1.92 vol points (slightly call-bid, balanced); P/C OI 0.8; ATM spread 59% of mid so the 8.08% event-implied move is indicative only. Run-up +18.1% over 5 sessions, +16.9% over 20, still -56.5% from 52w high. Sell side 10 Buy / 0 Hold, avg PT $28.80 (finviz); Earnings Whispers reports bullish sentiment fell to 20% from 64.6% before the last print. Insiders: 178k shares sold over 90 days, 0 bought (stocktitan).

findings.finding: On the morning of the print (Nov 12, 08:00 ET) HawkEye announced ~$135m of new contracts signed since Oct 1 (>$70m Europe, $65m US Government and other international) - in six weeks, against ~$50m of quarterly revenue and a $292.2m backlog at June 30; no recognition timing given; the stock traded -1.2% intraday after it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Two prints only: Q2 (Aug 13) beat revenue $49.8m vs $45.5m and gave a FY guide above consensus, stock -6.52%; Q1 (Jun 22) -2.71%. Prior contract releases moved the stock +1% (Sep 24, $18m) and +4.1% (Oct 15, $36m) per stocktitan.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public and the tape barely reacted (-1.2% at 13:15 ET), which says the market has not yet translated bookings into revenue/guide confidence; the translation comes on the call (whether these book-and-ship in Q4 against the $115-120m H2 requirement). If fully priced as guide support the stock would have gapped up today.
findings.independence: Company document. Q3 bookings release ($36m international, Oct 15) https://finviz.com/news/402989/hawkeye-360-secures-36-million-in-new-international-contracts-driven-by-increasing-demand-for-signals-intelligence shows a smaller Q3 cadence, so the Q4 step-up is new.

findings.finding: FY2026 revenue consensus $213.18m sits below the low end of the company's own $215-220m guide; with H1 at $99.6m and Q3 consensus ~$57m the street implies Q4 ~$56.6m, flat on Q3, while management said Q4 would be higher than Q3 - so a simple reaffirmation is a beat on the FY line.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: First guide (Aug 13) came above consensus ($215-220m vs $213.4m) and the stock fell 6.5% that session (Motley Fool); this name has not yet paid for guidance beats.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus below the guide floor means the street is haircutting management; the stock trading at $15 vs a $26 IPO and -39% since the last report is consistent with the market doubting the H2 ramp. If the market believed the guide, FY consensus would sit inside the range.
findings.independence: Guide from Q2 release https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001750704/000175070426000018/exhibit991-earningsrelease.htm ; Q2-call cadence (Q4 > Q3) from https://quartr.com/events/hawkeye-360-inc-hawk-q2-2026_FTic1ZBT . Shares the $135m bookings logic only in direction, not in fact.

findings.finding: Revenue was $49.8m in Q1 and $49.8m in Q2 (flat), the guide needs $115-120m in H2 (+16-20% on the H1 run-rate) with only $82m of backlog expected to convert in H2, and 69% of Q2 revenue was point-in-time fixed-price - a lumpy book on which the $57m Q3 bar (+14% q/q) can miss on a single delivery slipping.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 revenue beat by ~9.6% and the stock still fell 6.5%; no miss in the two-print history to measure.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced in the drawdown; what is not visible in the price is the size of the step-up required versus a flat H1 and how much depends on book-and-ship. Q3 ends Sep 30, the US federal fiscal year-end (58% of revenue is US), which usually helps point-in-time deliveries, so the sign is uncertain.
findings.independence: Q1 release https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001750704/000175070426000009/exhibit991-earningsrelease.htm ($49.8m Q1) and Q2 release ($49.8m Q2, $82m H2 backlog conversion per call summary https://www.barchart.com/story/news/3837612/hawkeye-360-announces-second-quarter-2026-financial-results).

findings.finding: Announced Q3 bookings were modest: $36m of multi-year international contracts for the quarter (Oct 15 release, includes the ~$18m Middle East award of Sep 24) against ~$21m/quarter of international revenue, plus an undisclosed-value NRO CRFCA award in August; backlog fell $302.7m to $285.0m in Q1 and rose only to $292.2m in Q2, so the Sep 30 backlog headline could be flat-to-down.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Backlog has not yet been a disclosed driver of a reaction; Q2 backlog +$7m q/q with the stock -6.5%.
findings.why_not_priced: Previews key on revenue and the guide, not on Q3 book-to-bill; the $135m Q4 release this morning reads like a pre-emptive offset to a soft Q3 bookings line, which is inference. Partly offset by finding 1, which covers a different period (post Oct 1).
findings.independence: Defense Post 2026-10-19 https://thedefensepost.com/2026/10/19/hawkeye360-signals-intelligence-deals/ (same $36m, NRO award unvalued). Backlog history from Q1 and Q2 releases.

findings.finding: Closest public peer BlackSky reported Q3 on Nov 5 after HawkEye last spoke: revenue $42.8m +118%, record adj. EBITDA $12.8m, FY guide raised (low end), stock ~$16.77 to ~$21.33; HAWK's +18% five-day run-up overlaps it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior HAWK reaction to a peer print available (listed since May 2026).
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced via the run-up; the residual is that government/international space-intelligence demand read-through supports HAWK's H2 ramp. If unpriced, HAWK would not be up 18% in five days.
findings.independence: Proxy (different modality, EO imagery vs RF). Earnings Whispers BKSY guide detail via https://finviz.com/news/417260/blackskys-record-gen-3-quarter-delivers-margin-breakout-and-higher-guidance-but-backlog-satellite-timing-and-a-soft-q4-setup-keep-the-market-skeptical

findings.finding: Positioning into the print: +18.1% in five sessions and +16.9% in 20 (baseline), on a name whose two prints both fell (-2.7%, -6.5%) including a revenue beat with a guide above consensus; short interest is only ~3.8% of float / ~2 days, so there is no squeeze fuel, and insiders sold 178k shares over 90 days with no buys.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is the price; the point is that the run-up has pre-spent part of a good print while the reaction function on this name has sold good news. If the run-up had been on short covering, short interest would have dropped sharply; it fell ~20% on a small base.
findings.independence: Run-up and reaction history from the sealed baseline; reaction to Q2 from https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/14/why-hawkeye-360-stock-crashed-friday

findings.finding: Management pre-guided Q3 adj. EBITDA to be similar to Q2's $7.0m with a Q4 ramp (FY $30-36m implies H2 $16-22m, Q4 ~$9-15m); consensus EPS -$0.03 vs -$0.07 - the profit line lands inside what the company already told the market.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 GAAP loss of $15.3m was cited as one reason the beat was sold (Motley Fool).
findings.why_not_priced: Inside guidance, so priced; filed for completeness - the risk is GAAP loss optics as in Q2.

findings.why_not_priced: Public and mostly priced; launches on time remove a Q4 execution risk to the guide that would otherwise show as a delay.

baseline_tension: The guide/bookings positives agree with the slightly call-bid skew and the +18% run-up, which is exactly why they look largely priced; the name's 0-for-2 reaction history cuts against them, leaving p_up just under 50.
